pages.title: The Helping Spell
pages.text: Carry a mage coat, mage hat and mage staff.

pages.title: The Helping Spell
pages.text: Prepare a magical companion with useful first spellbooks.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Golden Allays can be found in swamps. Their native progression uses this equipment and spellbooks. The quest checks the equipment, not a spell cast or completed transformation.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Use milk for Croissant Dragon, the required Mage gear for Golden Allay, or coins for hostile Imp. Native messages identify distinct taming prerequisites and prevent assuming a universal food.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Golden Allay takes its coat, hat and staff, then a suitable book. Transferring equipment and actually using a spell are distinct actions; inventory possession does not prove spell use.
